description: Full details of one otodom.pl listing (or a developer's project page): price, czynsz (rent_extra) and deposit (PLN), price per m², area and plot area, rooms, floor and the building's floor count, year built, building type and material, heating, ownership, condition, windows, energy certificate, availability date, market, address with district and coordinates, seller type and agency name, amenities/equipment as `features`, every other stated attribute in `details`, the full description and photo URLs. Contact phone numbers are not returned. For a development project, `development` gives its unit count, area range and completion date. Get the slug from otodom_search. Fetched live from otodom.pl (typically 0.3–1 s via direct fetch; ~5–10 s when it falls back to an unblocker). Result: { source, fetchedAt, offer: { id, slug, url, title, status, type, transaction, kind, market, price, rent_extra, deposit, price_per_m2, currency, price_on_request, area_m2, plot_area_m2, rooms, floor, floors_in_building, year_built, building_type, building_material, heating, ownership, condition, windows, energy_certificate, available_from, address, location_id, geo, seller_type, agency_name, agency_url, date_created, date_modified, features, details, description, photos, development? } }. Codes such as heating 'urban' (district heating) or condition 'ready_to_use' are Otodom's own. A removed listing is an error that says so.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

offer.description: The listing's slug from otodom_search (ends in -ID<code>, e.g. 'mieszkanie-4-pokojowe-w-mokotowie-z-balkonem-ID4sFig') or its otodom.pl URL (/pl/oferta/… or /pl/inwestycja/…).
